title: Palestinian killed, others injured in Israeli shelling of displacement tent in Gaza City - WAFA Agency
summary_or_snippet: Palestinian killed, others injured in Israeli shelling of displacement tent in Gaza City WAFA Agency GAZA, August 28, 2026 (WAFA) - A Palestinian was killed, and others were injured this evening in an Israeli shelling targeting a tent sheltering displaced persons in the Al-Mashahara area, east of Gaza City, local sources reported. Sources reported that the body of a slain Palestinian and several injured individuals were transferred to Al-Shifa Medical Complex following the shelling of a tent sheltering a large number of displaced people. The latest attack brought the number of Palestinians killed in Gaza since dawn today to five. Israeli forces have continued to carry out airstrikes and artillery shelling across various parts of Gaza City, amid ongoing artillery fire targeting the city's eastern and northern areas. T.R.

title: Palestinian killed, two injured in Israeli drone strike in Gaza City - WAFA Agency
summary_or_snippet: Palestinian killed, two injured in Israeli drone strike in Gaza City WAFA Agency GAZA, August 29, 2026 (WAFA) - A Palestinian was killed and two others were injured on Saturday after an Israeli drone struck an electric motorcycle in the Tal al-Hawa neighborhood, southwest of Gaza City. WAFA correspondent reported that the victim and the two injured Palestinians were taken to al-Quds Hospital following the strike. Since the ceasefire in Gaza took effect on October 11, 2025, around 1,313 Palestinians have been killed and more than 4,361 injured, while the bodies of 815 Palestinians have been recovered from under the rubble, according to Palestinian medical sources. Since the start of Israel's military offensive on Gaza in October 2023, 73,449 Palestinians have been killed and 174,472 injured, with around 90% of civilian infrastructure destroyed. The United Nations has estimated reconstruction costs at approximately $70 billion. M.N

title: Three Palestinians injured in Israeli drone strike on medicine warehouse at Gaza hospital - WAFA Agency
summary_or_snippet: Three Palestinians injured in Israeli drone strike on medicine warehouse at Gaza hospital WAFA Agency GAZA, August 29, 2026 (WAFA) - Three Palestinians were injured on Saturday after an Israeli drone struck a medicine warehouse inside the Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital in Deir al-Balah, central Gaza. Eyewitnesses said an Israeli drone carried out the strike on the medicine warehouse inside the hospital. The extent of the damage was not immediately known. The strike injured three Palestinians who were inside the hospital receiving medical care.
